extension.summary: Install Roc builds from Roc Repo
extension.description: Pick a build and a tier for this device. Every build opens a preview gallery first, with the install action at the top. Installs are fingerprint-verified (SHA-256) before anything is applied, your current setup is backed up first, and the installer finishes the job itself: addons switched on, Roc OS skin set, security lockdown applied. Trakt ships installed but off — sign in once, in one sitting, after the build settles.
Heavily restructured, advanced version of the original Internet Archive addon to watch and listen to media archived by Internet Archive
extension.disclaimer: This third party addon is not in any way commissioned or endorsed by Internet Archive

extension.summary: Roc OS — Eric's personal broadcast control room
extension.description: Roc OS is Eric's personal broadcast control room: a poster-forward home (Continue Watching + Trending rows over the build's own art, one clean floating dock), rooms that open straight onto the content — Cinema Room grids for Movies/TV, the War Room for Sports, a Music Room of songs and videos — and a floating glass panel that reads any title you rest on: poster, story, ratings, before you ever click. Kodi is the engine. Roc OS is the car.

extension.summary: Roc OS helper: PIN gate, daypart clock, focus memory, VPN surface
extension.description: The engine room of Roc OS (skin.rocos). Runs as a service: keeps the Day/Midday/Night wallpaper on the clock, remembers the last focused item per window and restores it on return, publishes the real VPN tunnel state to the dock shield, and gates the adult door behind a PIN that Eric sets himself on the device (stored only as a salted PBKDF2 hash in this addon's profile data).
extension.news: 0.7.17 - Resume seek-storm fix (2026-11-18): the service's pending-seek applier re-applied seekTime on every poll while the playhead read behind the target; a seek reopens the stream and the playhead reads behind target for the whole reopen (~15 s on the house HLS), so each re-apply restarted the reopen - measured on .155: 5 applies in 18 s against one Dune resume, the player EOF'd a second after the landing the storm finally allowed and RocPlay's hold loop had no living player to hold. Applies are now keyed to (arm, file), spaced 30 s apart and capped at 3 per file; a file change (a real failover) re-keys and re-arms, preserving the 0.5.15 failover re-apply. Everything 0.7.16 carried is unchanged. 0.7.16 - ONE BUNDLE finish pass (2026-11-18): restore six.py and resources/data/roc_rocplay.json - the 0.7.15 tree shipped rocui_playback.py and rocui_nextup.py doing 'from six.moves import urllib_parse' with no six module anywhere, so detail_resume_play crashed on import (ModuleNotFoundError: six, seen in .159 kodi.log on the Dune resume click) and the RESUME button did nothing; and the Roc Play player template was missing, so the service could not seed it into TMDb Helper's players folder ('rocplay player resource missing' in the log) and the Helper play route would dead-end. six.py is the rocui family's own copy (1.15.0); roc_rocplay.json is the assembly vault's current template (auto=1, relaxed asserts movie [] / episode [season, episode]). Everything 0.7.15 carried is unchanged. 0.7.15 - ONE BUNDLE finish pass (2026-11-18): restore rocui_gate.py (the Nov 10 build's copy) - the 0.7.14 tree shipped service.py and default.py importing rocui_gate while the module itself was missing, so the rocui service crashed on import (ModuleNotFoundError, seen in .159 kodi.log) and the resume_play/source_select actions crashed the same way; the service's daypart clock, focus memory, VPN surface, Trakt publishing, gate ticks and preview dwell were all dead. route_gate_open() is fail-open (no property yet reads as open), so restoring the module cannot block playback. Everything 0.7.14 carried is unchanged. 0.7.14 - ONE BUNDLE finish pass (2026-11-17): new script action open_title (coll/tmdb_id/tmdb_type) routing a Home row poster click into open_collection_title, so a poster opens its own title page (Eric's poster law, 2026-11-17 22:23) instead of the section hub the old list-level ActivateWindow onclick forced. Everything 0.7.13 carried is unchanged. 0.7.13 - ONE BUNDLE (2026-11-17): TV store-only show PLAY fix. show_progress_target now falls back to the Roc Sync store when legacy history holds no qualifying target: a show whose episode progress lives only in the store (the normal case since Roc Sync went live) lights CONTINUE WATCHING with the store's episode and position on BOTH the hub and collection routes (one shared function; detail_main_play recomputes from it at click time). History still wins whenever it qualifies (unchanged precedence, floors, finished rule and next-episode verification - the store path mirrors them exactly). No store row, below-floor, or finished-without-verifiable-next still reads PLAY S1E1. Everything 0.7.12 carried is unchanged. 0.7.12 - Merged build (2026-11-17): the Collections detail-page RESUME fix and the stale remembered-source fix ship as one tree. Collections route (open_collection_title) now mirrors stage_open's Roc Sync layers 4/4b for movies: a movie whose checkpoint lives in the Roc Sync store shows RESUME from a Collection (MCU: Story Order included) with the same '- stopped at H:MM:SS - N% watched' label as from Continue Watching, and pressing it arms the store position in pending_seek.json for RocPlay (0.2.11+) exactly as the hub route does. Before, the collection route checked only legacy local history, so store-only checkpoints (the normal case since Roc Sync went live) showed no RESUME from a collection at all. No fake buttons: a movie with no checkpoint still shows PLAY only; TV show pages through collections are unchanged. Folds in 0.7.11 below (remembered-source delegation to RocPlay 0.2.14) - rocui_playback.py is byte-identical to that build. 0.7.11 - Stale remembered-source fix (2026-11-17): _play_remembered's http(s) route no longer replays the remembered URL directly — it hands the URL to RocPlay (0.2.14) as remembered_url with auto=1, and RocPlay tries it first inside its own ladder. The old direct replay verified only the first seconds and walked away; a stale URL that started, took the resume seek and died seconds later stranded the viewer (The Odyssey / Breaking Bad, .159 2026-11-17). Now a fast death is recorded by RocPlay with its reason and the play falls through to the full well hunt on its own. The seek stays armed and is consumed exactly as on the Helper route. Direct replay remains only as the fallback for a device without RocPlay. 0.7.10 - Zero-source shelf (2026-11-17, Eric's order): browse shelves rocui serves (Home spotlight + NEW rows, hub rows, Toonime shelves, collections) now drop any title RocPlay has proven to have zero WORKING sources on THIS device (plugin.video.rocplay 0.2.13 availability verdicts, master-profile, per-device). Unchecked/unknown titles are never suppressed; suppressed titles auto-restore when a re-check finds sources (background service tick: unknown first, zero verdicts re-checked after 24 h, ok verdicts refreshed after 7 days, idle only). Search results are deliberately NOT filtered (search is not a shelf) and Continue Watching is exempt — in-progress titles never vanish. Display filter only: no catalog data edited or deleted. 0.7.4 - Fleet catch-up (2026-11-16): search input on every search bar (MIC voice via the RocOS Voice helper + PHONE typing page with live suggestions, served by this service on port 9898); YouTube readiness gate (RocOS.YouTubeReady) so the Music hub can never fire the API-keys nag unprompted; OSD source-label fallback stamping; resume percent truth (a literal 0 no longer renders, Roc Sync store fills the real percent); IA album doors scoped to real albums. 0.7.3 - Trakt label truth fix (2026-11-15, Eric's direct order): rocui_common's Trakt publisher read BOTH halves of the credential pair from locations the Helper's credential migration emptied/moved, so it could only ever report 'disconnected'. (1) _trakt_stored_token now reads the token from the sync module (script.module.tmdbhelper.sync.trakt, setting 'token') FIRST, with the Helper's legacy 'trakt_token' setting as fallback for unmigrated installs (measured 2026-11-15: legacy value length 0, sync token present and working, syncs succeeding, zero 401s — yet Home showed 'Sign in to Trakt'). (2) _trakt_client_id now reads the public client id from the sync module's api/keys.py FIRST, legacy helper api_keys/trakt.py as fallback — the helper file no longer exists, so the live check could never run (ENOENT on every publish). No sign-in behaviour changes; nobody signs into Trakt; token presence alone still never publishes 'connected' — the live /users/me 200 does. Nothing else changes vs 0.7.2. 0.7.2 - Bundle (2026-11-12): (1) seed roc_rocplay.json carries the player lane's relaxed asserts (movie [] / episode [season, episode]) so seed-repair can never revert the empty-box fix; (2) carries the Nov-11 bedroom ROC-GATEFIX (NL-verdict grace 1800 s + 2 extra egress endpoints + lookup timeout 4→8 s) which the 2.0.26 work tree did not contain — bedroom keeps its live gate behaviour, fleet-wide. Nothing else changes vs 0.7.1. 0.6.8 - VPN region readout + transition states + Home fix button (2026-11-10, file-side only, NOT deployed -- waits for Eric's launch word): publish_vpn_state now also publishes RocVPN.Region (full name) / RocVPN.RegionCode / RocVPN.Phase / RocVPN.Target / RocVPN.TargetOK / RocVPN.Display. REGION: the tunnel's real exit country from an egress-IP geolocation lookup made THROUGH the tunnel (https://ipapi.co/json/, https://ipwho.is/ fallback; keyless HTTPS; a verdict needs a 2-letter code AND a country name; a region is never guessed). Cache law (vpn_region_cache.json): a verified region is trusted 300s; any publish that sees the tunnel down destroys the cached region verdict (phase/fix bookkeeping survives); failed lookups retry at most once a minute. PHASE (display-only; detect_vpn_state and the gate are untouched): 'connected' when the tunnel carries traffic; 'connecting' when a real tunnel interface exists with no traffic yet and has been in that shape under 120s (a stalled tunnel falls back to the settled word); 'disconnecting' is deliberately NOT rendered -- teardown removes the interface and interface-down is indistinguishable from a dead tunnel, so the poll source cannot prove it. DISPLAY (Eric's abbreviation call: codes, not whole words): on+NL 'VPN ● NL', on+elsewhere 'VPN ● <CODE>' (said plainly, on purpose -- the honest words are the alarm), on+unverified 'VPN on', connecting 'VPN connecting… <CODE>' when the target is honestly known else 'VPN connecting…', off 'VPN off', unknown 'VPN ?'. extension.summary: Roc Sync — the house's own watch tracking (Trakt replacement)
extension.description: Design A (locked 2026-11-13): one JSON store per profile inside that profile's own userdata subtree, written ONLY by this service (atomic writes, SHA-256 hash chain, tombstones so removals never resurrect). Capture is Eric's mechanism (2026-11-16): the press from pause to play writes the checkpoint — profile, title, the position where it was paused — for shows, movies and songs; stop and 60-second safety saves are secondary, near-end marks watched. The plugin side serves each profile's Continue Watching row from its own store's progress and resumes through Roc Play with a service-applied seek. No Trakt calls, no token, no network dependency for tracking (TMDb is read for artwork only).
extension.news: 0.1.5 - Bundle completeness fix (2026-11-18): service.py — the service entry point addon.xml declares (the store's single writer + the pending-seek applier for the plugin play route) — was MISSING from the 0.1.4 bundle tree, so the shipped tree could not run the service at all. No behaviour change to either feature. 0.1.0 — first build (2026-11-16, Eric's order "Let's get the Roc Sync up and going"): service (single writer, seed import with MANIFEST hash verification, chain recovery, pause->play checkpoint capture + checkpoints.jsonl, stop/safety saves, watched marking, pending-seek applier) + plugin (Continue Watching directory per profile, play route arming the seek and handing off to Roc Play auto=1). extension.summary: Roc OS playback chain — every well at once
extension.description: Roc-owned movie/TV playback: asks every source well in parallel, merges the pour, fails over automatically when a source won't start. No third-party Python dependencies (stdlib only).
extension.news: 0.2.19 - Resume failover (2026-11-18): a source can play linearly yet die ON the resume seek (proven on .155: the Movy goldenkite 2160p HLS stream plays through the resume region but EOFs ~1 s after any seek landing from this exit — a controlled lone seek with no addon involvement died the same way). When the hold loop ends resume_hold_player_stopped, the play now fails over to the next source in the same fan-out order and re-applies the SAME checkpoint there (Eric's day-1 autoplay law applied to resume), bounded by the source line exactly like normal autoplay — remembered leg, first pour, second pour, no loops. New flight events: resume_failover, resume_failover_recovered, resume_failover_exhausted, remembered_resume_fallthrough. If the whole line dies on the seek the play stops cleanly with an honest toast and NO source picker on any profile (picker law unchanged). _apply_resume now returns its outcome string; seeks, re-seeks, caps and the hold budget are exactly 0.2.18's, and a live-but-unheld resume still never breaks a working start. 0.2.18 - Resume hold terminal events (2026-11-18): _apply_resume's hold loop now records WHY it exited without a held landing - resume_hold_player_stopped / resume_hold_aborted / resume_hold_unheld - instead of leaving the flight record silent after resume_applied (on .155 the player EOF'd ~1 s after the landing and the record showed nothing; the diagnosis needed a kodi.log pull). No behaviour change: seeks, re-seeks, caps and the hold budget are exactly 0.2.17's. Everything 0.2.17 carried is unchanged. 0.2.17 - VidSrc token loader (2026-11-18): VidSrc playback died past the master playlist — the generate token rides only the master URL and Kodi's ffmpeg demuxer does not propagate it to the variant/segment requests, which the stream host 403s (403 without the token, 200 with it, proven live from the house exit). A VidSrc source now plays through a local playlist-rewriting proxy (resources/lib/tokenloader.py) that stamps the token + the well's Referer/UA onto every sub-request — the site's own TokenLoader contract — and the plugin holds the proxy alive until the player leaves the file, so seeks and variant re-reads keep working. Proven offline (unit suite + stub trace against this code), live-fire against a token-enforcing local origin (master/variant/segment all arrive stamped; the unstamped control dies 403), and end-to-end from the house exit (Dune: Part Two resolved by the fixed well, played through the proxy, segment ffprobe-read). Nothing else changes vs 0.2.16. 0.2.16 - Resume hold (2026-11-18): _apply_resume now HOLDS the checkpoint after the win instead of firing one seek — a bounded hold loop (60 s, max 3 re-seeks) re-seeks when a mid-start stream reopen throws the playhead back to the start or swaps the playing file while still behind the target (the Dune chooser-route failure, reproduced on .155 with 0.2.15). A landing that stays at/past the target for 5 s ends the hold (resume_held); every outcome stays flight-recorder logged. Nothing else changes vs 0.2.15. 0.2.15 - ONE BUNDLE finish pass (2026-11-18): restore the missing playback modules - the 0.2.14 tree shipped resources/lib/wellcore.py importing stagelog and the wells package while both were absent, so the plugin crashed on import (ModuleNotFoundError: stagelog, seen in .159 kodi.log) and no playback could start at all. Restored from the assembly vault (.159 pre-bundle snapshot): wells/ (VixSrc, Movy, VidZee, VidMario, VidSrc, MP4Hydra) plus stagelog.py, rohttp.py, aes.py from the Nov 10 source-watch stage lib. FRONT_WELLS is unchanged (VixSrc, Movy, VidZee, VidMario); Cinejoy/Cno/TheDaddy remain unwired (post-bundle wave). Everything 0.2.14 carried is unchanged. 0.2.14 - Stale remembered-source fix (2026-11-17): play() accepts remembered_url (rocui's per-title source memory, handed in by rocui 0.7.11) and tries it FIRST, before the fan-out, through the ordinary _try_source contract — a remembered URL that dies inside its start window records its F2 source_failed reason + death mark and the play falls through to the full well hunt on its own; a remembered source that plays behaves exactly as the old direct route did (no fan-out delay). Replaces rocui's direct replay, whose start verification walked away after the first seconds and stranded the viewer when a stale URL died just after the seek landed (The Odyssey / Breaking Bad, .159 2026-11-17). 0.2.13 - Zero-source shelf (2026-11-17, Eric's order): per-device availability verdicts + source death marks. Every completed pour stamps a title's working-source verdict (master-profile availability.json, read by script.rocui's shelf filter); a new action=avail_check runs the full pour (fanout + second pour) for one title and stamps the verdict without playing. Death marks (deep-dive F-10 negative learning): a source is dead for a title only after 3+ recorded start failures spanning 24h+ inside 7 days; one stall is never a death; a confirmed start deletes its marks (revival). Marks never touch the ladder — they only feed the shelf's working-source count. The 0.2.12 second pour and the resume checkpoint are unchanged (wellcore gains only additive last-pour verdict exposure for the completeness test). 0.2.12 - Thin-pour fix: second pour (re-join cut wells + reserve) before all_failed; source_failed records why a source died.

extension.news:
## v7.4.4+roc1 (Roc vendored patch, 2026-11-09) - data_client.api_request: the no-API-key abort now shows a non-blocking notification instead of the modal OK dialog, ending the per-row modal loop on skin-fed windows. Request abort + logging unchanged; sign-in/key-entry flows untouched.
## v7.4.4 ### Fixed - Fix not including FolderPath in current container details - Fix current plugin item window properties sometimes not updating correctly - Fix not updating remote history upon consecutive playback events for certain video types - Fix using unimplemented change to localisation identifier when showing API config page address - Fix play uri parameters/properties not being able to be forced off - Limit retrying feeds that cannot be accessed
### Changed - Improve responsiveness of service loop upon plugin invocation - Log redacted visitorData details - More aggressively utilise cached data for My Subscriptions feed failures
### New - Add option to play YouTube error notification video upon playback failure
